findings.trigger: Federated simulation with bank.id in bank_data (partitioned local training) and enable_dp=True with dp_mode='opacus'
findings.expected_behavior: Execute train_local_with_opacus using Opacus PrivacyEngine with per-sample gradient clipping, Gaussian noise, and return actual_epsilon for privacy budget accounting.
findings.actual_behavior: The code called standard plaintext train_local instead of train_local_with_opacus, hardcoded actual_epsilon to None, bypassed post-hoc DP, and skipped record_opacus_epsilon entirely. Models were trained completely in the clear without DP protection despite UI/API claims.
findings.threat_correctness_impact: Complete silent bypass of Differential Privacy guarantees during partitioned federated training. The simulation reported Opacus DP active while training in unprivatized plaintext.
findings.root_cause: Omission of branching logic on use_opacus_dp within the direct bank_data partition training block in simulation_service.py.
findings.repair_strategy: Branch on use_opacus_dp in bank_data loop: invoke model_service.train_local_with_opacus, pass target_epsilon, target_delta, max_grad_norm, and populate train_res['actual_epsilon'].

findings.trigger: Invocation of apply_secure_aggregation_masks with empty client list or single client.
findings.expected_behavior: Gracefully return unmodified client weights or empty list.
findings.actual_behavior: Directly indexed client_weights[0].flat_weights without length check, causing IndexError on empty list, and invalid zero-sum masking for single-client scenarios.
findings.threat_correctness_impact: Crash on empty participant sets or corrupted model update on single-client rounds.
findings.repair_strategy: Added guard: if not client_weights or len(client_weights) < 2: return list(client_weights).

findings.trigger: Empty client weights passed to TEE secure aggregation or zero-length parameter vectors passed to FHE encryption.
findings.actual_behavior: IndexError on empty client weights in TEE aggregation; silent generation of empty dummy ciphertexts in FHE driver.
findings.threat_correctness_impact: Unhanded runtime crash or silent zero-byte cryptographic operations.
findings.repair_strategy: Added explicit ValueError guards for empty weights in both drivers.

findings.trigger: Simulation launched with invalid DP parameters (e.g. negative epsilon, delta <= 0 or >= 1, non-positive clipping norm).
findings.expected_behavior: Fail closed at initialization before starting federated training.
findings.actual_behavior: Simulation proceeded to training and only failed mid-round during noise calculation.
findings.threat_correctness_impact: Wasted computation and delayed failure reporting.
findings.root_cause: Validation of DP configuration was performed downstream rather than at simulation start.
findings.repair_strategy: Added early fail-closed validation check in run_simulation for dp_epsilon, dp_delta, and dp_max_grad_norm.
